reasons: The insertion completes every atomic element of the locked fallback level: professional and workmanlike Services, 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day Services conformance measured from performance, and the full repair/replacement/refund remedy set.

Preferred level is not met (90 days rather than 12 months for software, 30 rather than 90 days for Services, and no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranties), which is consistent with the locked fallback target.

Minimality holds: a single concise warranty paragraph was added where no performance warranty existed at all; no preferred-only durations, re-performance remedy, or boilerplate were smuggled in, and no existing sentence was rewritten.

Intent is preserved: Section 13.5 funding warranty and the Section 13.6.2 disclaimer remain fully effective, and the disclaimer's 'EXCEPT AS OTHERWISE SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13' carve-out keeps the new warranty operative.

Minor note only (not a deviation): 'Services', 'software' and 'documentation' are not defined terms in this co-development agreement, so they will be read in their ordinary sense; a cross-reference to the relevant work statement would tighten scope.
